text:
Predicates:
Player(x) ::: x is a football player.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
KnownAs(x, y) ::: x is commonly known as y.
LoanedOutTo(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
Club(x) ::: x is a football club.
SameClub(x, y) ::: x is a football club along with y.
Premises:
Player(ailton) ∧ BornIn(ailton, 1995) ∧ KnownAs(ailton, ailton) ∧ LoanedOutTo(ailton, braga) ∧ PlaysFor(ailton, nautico) ∧ PlaysFor(nautico, nautico) ∧ SameClub(nautico, braga) ∧ Club(fuminense) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is commonly known as Ailton. Ailton is a football player who was loaned out to Braga. Ailton Silva is a Brazilian footballer who plays for Nautico. Nautico is a football club along with Braga. Fluminense is a football club.
Conclusion:
¬LoanedOutTo(ailton, club) ::: Ailton was not loaned out to a football club.
